note: Thresholds from pack-distinct-calibration.spec.ts. Each score has an alike line (null when its calibration found no gap of 0.1 at both viewports, so it doesn't vote) and a clone floor. A pair fails when its pixels are under their alike line, whatever its tokens say (the token line decides only while the pixels have none), or when either score is under its clone floor. For a design language the token score reads only the groups a static render shows (corners, depth, borders, density), and the material (surface) only when the composition's render shows a visible Surface primitive (`material` records that detection and its reason); focus, motion, states, icons, texture, and an unrendered material are informational lines that never score. `pinned` true holds `composition` as the scored one whatever the coverage procedure picks, and `procedurePick` records that pick and its coverage. `enforced` true fails the run on a failing pair no ruling names, on any clone, and on a ruling whose pair fails nowhere (unneeded); false only reports. For a color scheme the perceptual score is ΔE00 (`de`, CIEDE2000) over the canvas, the primary and secondary text, the accent, and the default, subtle, and raised (prominent) surfaces, in each base mode, from the colors the render computes, each mode combined as the mean of its roles, and the worse mode's mean over 50 decides (a mean over 50 counts as 1), so a pair under the line in either mode fails whatever the other does (lead A, the LANG-5b fix round; before it, one mean over both modes let a dark-only twin pass); a role under a ΔE00 of 2 is flagged near and never votes. The ΔE00 scale of 50 was chosen so the controls' gap can vote (over 100 the nearest family pair, at a mean ΔE00 of 7.5, never cleared calibrate()'s 0.1), and the calibrated line, alike under a mean ΔE00 of 3.8, is the decision (lead A, LANG-4). The edges are dropped: no `px` line, and a scheme pair is never judged on them. Generator schemes are unscorable without the owner's input and never counted as distinct (`skipped`). The ΔE00 alike line is kept at 0.076 (a mean of 3.8) by decision; recalibrate after the surge (lead A, 2026-10-30). Derived roles may shift up to 2.0 ΔE00 for contrast, hue within 5°; beyond that, lead review (lead A, 2026-10-30).

rulings.why: reduced-chroma is low in saturation on purpose, for visitors who want less color, so it sits near a gray scheme; its purpose is the point, not its look (LANG-4, kept unchanged by LANG-5).

cool-color-safe is the color-blind-safe option and doesn't move. neutral-slate isn't a keep: scored per mode it sat 3.17 (light) and 3.78 (dark) from cool-color-safe, so the LANG-5b fix round moved neutral-slate instead, to 5.33 and 5.11 (lead A, 2026-10-30), and LANG-5e lifted its dark slate further apart, to 5.83.

signal-paper keeps its paper and signal accent unchanged; LANG-5b moved paper-ink's light away from it instead, and LANG-5d made paper-ink one dove-grey stock in both modes, so the pair no longer fails: per mode after 5d, light 14.04 and dark 10.75, over the line. It rules no pair; enforced, a ruling that rules nothing failing is unneeded.
